svg.title: K-nearest neighbours classifier
svg.desc: A k-nearest neighbours classifier has no fitted structure: the model is its stored reference rows, on the standardised scale. A new row takes the class mix of the 15 nearest of them. The axes are the two principal components of the stored rows: the first is led by amount +0.67, velocity +0.67, merchant_risk -0.29; the second is led by account_age +0.72, merchant_risk -0.64, velocity -0.23.
